text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Fan Fest—a huge sporting
event
where Tracen Academy opens its
doors to the
fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As for which activity Wonder Acute will
be
joining...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I've actually played before, you know.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty sure the proper stance is...
something
like this? Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a fairly traditional game, but I
honestly would
never have pegged her
for a golfer.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Huh... By the way, do you know where
the wickets
are?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It appears she's mistaken golf for
croquet. That
means golf isn't going to
be an option, which
leaves...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Woo-hoo! Boxing it is! Was there really
any other
choice?!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Now that I look more closely, the
contest
name is a little different. "Art
boxing"?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rather than landing punches against an

opponent, the winner is determined by
their
endurance and the aesthetic of
their techniques.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What's more, some rather powerful
opponents
have already started going at
it.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Art boxing, eh? Maybe I can put my
savate
techniques to good use.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hah! Yah! Hup! Grah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's Sirius Symboli, an experienced

practitioner of the French martial art
savate.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Boxing was part of my body-toning
regimen for a
time.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: One, two! One, two!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's also Gold City, a runner who also
works as
a model.
And the judge's
verdict is...

text_block_list.name: Judge
text_block_list.text: That'll do, you two. Great effort today.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Huh? So I'm not advancing to the final?
What's
the big deal?

text_block_list.name: Judge
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli, you occasionally included
kicks in
your performance. As for you,
Gold City...

text_block_list.name: Judge
text_block_list.text:
You kept making eye contact and
striking flashy
poses between your
moves...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Old habits are hard to break...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
One, two! One, two!
Princess ☆ Knuckle
Sandwich!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Crack!

text_block_list.name: Judge
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess is disqualified.
Making contact
with the fence is strictly
forbidden!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Among all the drama and hubbub,
Wonder Acute
strings together steady
victories, advancing all
the way to the
finals.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to an honorable
match.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I cannot tell you how grateful I am for
this chance
to face someone with actual
boxing experience.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho. Thank you, Yaeno. You're
looking as
splendid and imposing as
ever. But yes, let's have
a good match.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute is pitted against Yaeno
Muteki, an
Umamusume well-versed in
ancient martial arts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her form is elegant, her breathing
unperturbed...
Everything she does is
nearly flawless. And so, the
two begin
their endless performance.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hup! Haaah! Hiyaa!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I must persevere with perfectly
coordinated
movements! The last one
standing shall be
crowned the victor!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: One, two! Three, four!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(Yaeno is incredible. I can't believe she
hasn't
even shed a drop of sweat.)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(This doesn't look good... But even
so—I'm still
the daughter of a former pro
boxer!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: One, two! Three, four!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute hangs in there, fighting
tooth and
nail. As I watch her, I'm
overcome with emotion.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer?! Thank you for cheering me on.
I... I can
do it!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I'll burn red hot until I burn out! Hyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She keeps punching with every ounce of
energy
she has.
And the verdict is...

text_block_list.name: Judge
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki wins!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Um... Are you all right, Acute?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Yaeno...
I'm... I'm...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm all burned out... Burned down to
white ash...
Oh golly...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everyone watching is touched by
Wonder Acute's
tremendous effort and
gives a warm round of
applause.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She fought to the brink and came back
stronger
despite her loss. Surely crossing
this tear-stained
bridge will lead us to a
brighter future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute hangs in there, fighting
tooth and
nail. The fans look on as her
gentle soul
challenges the invincible
queen of martial arts.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: You can do it, Acute! Hang in there!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
That's right! You've still got some fight
left!
C'mon, Acute!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Acute! Acute!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: (These... cheers...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Reeling but still on her feet, Wonder
Acute keeps
at it. Her courage touches
the hearts of all
onlookers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Until finally...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... Huff, huff... Can't... breathe...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable. How can she still be
standing?!
She's all out of breath...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(I can't see my own fists anymore... And
my legs
feel like lead... But...)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm not giving up!
One, two! One, two!

text_block_list.name: Judge
text_block_list.text:
I'm calling it now! The winner is Wonder
Acute!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheers erupt, and the fans swarm around
Wonder
Acute.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I fight my way through the jostling
crowd,
attempting to reach her.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Oh, Traaainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The excitement has reached a fever
pitch. No one
cares about the result
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I did it! I gave it all I had!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The music ringing out is like a hymn of
life,
dedicated to those who pushed
themselves to the
limit.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations. That was an impressive
display,
Acute. However...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
This seems to have become quite a
spectacle. I
thought it was merely a
lighthearted martial arts
contest...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the support of countless fans in her
corner,
Wonder Acute becomes art
boxing's world
champion... I think.
